score_scope: Frozen C82 on published official fixed validation, 680 terrains, 2330 maps per band. No training, model tuning, weight/prior or submission change.

official.scope: complete official fixed validation,2330maps/band; not hidden test
official.scorer: Reused previously verified unmodified official score_submission.py and metrics.py

complete.definition: error=predicted pathloss minus label; negative means predicted received power too strong. Shares relative to total masked SSE in the same band.

frequency_and_mask.dual_band: 5.775 minus 415 measured on joint valid positions, minus FSPL frequency difference
frequency_and_mask.mask_edge: Valid pixel with at least one invalid same-band pixel within raster Euclidean radius 2 (does not include exterior). Mask is only used in the audit.

shift_controls.scope: Interior 252x252 only, both folds evaluated. One set of true labels estimates per-map or per-tile shifts/offsets, the other checkerboard parity tests. This is a diagnostic, unavailable at inference. Per-pixel oracle uses its own target and is more optimistic.
shift_controls.fit_offset: additive constant to predicted PL; at least 4 valid fit-parity pixels per tile, else identity

prespecified_sample_weak_sites.source: Official VAL only. Uniform 2048 sites per map before masking. Weak = total pathloss greater than the weakest intact direct reference plus 3 dB. True flag available for diagnosis only.

frozen_physics_replay.scope: Frozen C78 coefficients fitted on TRAIN C76 research counterpart applied unchanged to C82 as a diagnostic on the fixed official validation panel. These corrections are not a C82-trained model or an official full score. Reflectance tests are first-order only.

illustrations.scope: Illustrative only. Pair comprised opposite mistakes at joint-valid, conservatively certified sites in the same map within 12 grid pixels. Choose a terrain in the middle half of terrain RMSE and prefer moderate 10 dB actual weak excess and a short separation.

blocked_example.group: blocked beyond two pixels from boundary

output_scope_limit: C82 errors measured on released total PL; original per-ray hits, visibility and original RX interpolation weights not in release. Canonical groups are model-derived. Shift oracle and block oracles are diagnostics, not candidate scores.
